resources.string: Remove \"%1$s\". Profiles referencing this tunnel will fail to connect until you pick another one.
Add a WireGuard config to route individual connection profiles through it — no system-wide VPN required.

Paste a wg-quick style config or load a .conf file. Only [Interface] and [Peer] fields are read; unknown keys (PostUp, Table, MTU) are ignored. Hostname endpoints and DNS names are resolved at tunnel start.

Generate an auth key in the Tailscale admin console (Settings → Keys), or in your Headscale CLI (`headscale preauthkeys create`). yySlide joins your tailnet on first use and reuses the node state after that, so a one-time key is fine. Reusable keys let you reconnect after reinstall.
Leave blank for Tailscale\'s hosted control plane. Set a Headscale URL for a self-hosted coordination server.
Experimental — yySlide implements the same WebSocket wire protocol as `cloudflared access ssh`. Tested against a small set of tenants.

Route SSH through a Cloudflare Tunnel published hostname — the in-app equivalent of `cloudflared access ssh --hostname <host>`. Public Tunnel routes need only a hostname. Access-protected routes additionally require a JWT — tap Sign in to capture one via your team\'s IdP.
No JWT — only works for unprotected Tunnel routes
Only needed for Access-protected routes; lets yySlide capture the team-domain cookie as a fallback if the per-app one is missing.
For bastion-mode multi-target tunnels, this is forwarded as `Cf-Access-Jump-Destination`. Leave blank for one-target routes.
For headless setups, run `cloudflared access token --app https://<hostname>` on another machine and paste the JWT here. Expiry is parsed from the token automatically.
